title: Three Times The Fun
meta_description: Pet-friendly 4BR coastal home with a bikes, screened porch \& pool access---just minutes to 30A beaches, trails, shops \& dining!
description_expanded:
ABOUT THIS HOME: As soon as you step inside Three Times the Fun you'll be instantly swept away by the 10-foot ceilings and spacious gathering areas. This stunning coastal 4 bedroom, pet friendly home can comfortably accommodate up to 12 guests. There's plenty of space to spread out and enjoy the wonderful mornings or evening sunset, while relaxing on the screened-in porch!

\*\*\* Heated Community Pool \*\*\*
\*\*\* 2 Complimentary Bikes \*\*\*

ABOUT THE AREA: The resort-style community pool in the Highland Park neighborhood is conveniently located a few doors away and the neighborhood borders the state forest and provides access to the Point Washington State Forest Hiking Trails. There are restaurants, shopping, and multiple beach accesses within walking or biking distance. Between the mornings spent sipping coffee in the salty breeze and the evening sunset strolls, a stay at Three Times The Fun will have you soaking up a luxurious Florida lifestyle.

BEACH ACCESS: Take a stroll to Blue Mountain Regional Beach, just a short ride from the house. At the entrance to the neighborhood, take a left, continue on 30A for about a mile then take a right on Blue Mountain Rd, at the stop light, turn right and you have made it to the beach. This beach has bathrooms, showers, and parking. You can also take a right on 30a from the community for about a mile. Take a left on Gulfview Heights Street (Famous Goatfeathers is on the corner) a Gulfview Heights Regional Beach Access is at the end of the road.

ACCOMMODATIONS:
• Bedroom 1 - Queen, ensuite (plus a pull-out couch, sleeps 2)
• Bedroom 2 - King, ensuite (crib in closet)
• Bedroom 3 -- Queen
• Bedroom 4 -- Twin/Full bunk, twin trundle, full futon

PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:
• Seasonally heated community pool
• 2 Bikes
• Pet Friendly 2 dogs max; $250/dog NRF
• Grill -- Propane
• Screened-in porch with TV
• Crib in Master Bed
• Bob Stroller in garage
• Smart TVs
• Coffee Maker -- traditional \& pod
• Full linen package: bedding \& bath
• Starter kit: toilet paper, paper towels, dishwasher, and washing machine pods
• Fully stocked kitchen

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- This home allows up to 2 pets for a fee; undisclosed pets brought without AvantStay's approval may result in a $500 fine per pet.
- The property includes 2 complimentary bikes for guest use.

Parking Details:
- This home includes 2 parking spaces with additional parking in the garage. There is additional parking available at the Grayton Beach Shuttle Parking Area.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.
